name: Generic d20
description: Six abilities, skills and weapon attacks. Built in; use it as a starting point for your own format.

items.label: Short rest
items.sub: Second Wind and Action Surge back

items.label: Long rest
items.sub: Hit points, spell slots and short-rest abilities back to full; death saves cleared

columns.label: Hit
columns.value: pick(row.ability, str_mod, dex_mod, con_mod, int_mod, wis_mod, cha_mod) + prof * row.prof + row.bonus
columns.roll: d20 + pick(row.ability, str_mod, dex_mod, con_mod, int_mod, wis_mod, cha_mod) + prof * row.prof + row.bonus

columns.label: Damage
columns.modifier: pick(row.ability, str_mod, dex_mod, con_mod, int_mod, wis_mod, cha_mod) + row.bonus

presets.name: Blinded
presets.effect: Can't see. Fails checks that need sight. Attacks against it have advantage, its attacks have disadvantage.

presets.name: Charmed
presets.effect: Can't attack the charmer. The charmer has advantage on social checks against it.

presets.name: Deafened
presets.effect: Can't hear. Fails checks that need hearing.

presets.name: Frightened
presets.effect: Disadvantage on checks and attacks while the source of fear is in sight. Can't move closer to it.

presets.name: Grappled
presets.effect: Speed is 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or it is moved out of reach.

presets.name: Invisible
presets.effect: Can't be seen. Attacks against it have disadvantage, its attacks have advantage.

presets.name: Paralyzed
presets.effect: Incapacitated, can't move or speak. Fails Str and Dex saves. Attacks against it have advantage; hits from within 5 ft are critical.

presets.name: Petrified
presets.effect: Turned to stone. Incapacitated, unaware, resistant to all damage.

presets.name: Poisoned
presets.effect: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

presets.name: Prone
presets.effect: Crawls only. Disadvantage on attacks. Melee attacks against it have advantage, ranged have disadvantage. Standing costs half the speed.

presets.name: Restrained
presets.effect: Speed is 0. Attacks against it have advantage, its attacks have disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dex saves.

presets.name: Stunned
presets.effect: Incapacitated, can't move, speaks only falteringly. Fails Str and Dex saves. Attacks against it have advantage.

presets.name: Unconscious
presets.effect: Incapacitated, can't move or speak, unaware. Drops what it holds, falls prone. Fails Str and Dex saves. Hits from within 5 ft are critical.

presets.name: Concentrating
presets.effect: Maintaining a spell. A hit forces a Constitution save or the spell ends.
